# GoalIcon

<!-- description:start -->
Displays a colored icon for a Tracker goal entity. The icon color is deterministically derived from the `goalId`, so the same goal always renders the same color across sessions and environments.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {GoalIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<GoalIcon goalId={456} />
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * Goal ID used to generate a deterministic color.
     * Accepts either a numeric shortId or a string entity ID.
     */
    goalId: number | string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the root element.
     */
    className?: string;

    /**
     * Entity type label. Defaults to "goal".
     */
    type?: string;

    /**
     * Size of the SVG icon inside the container in pixels.
     * @default 16
     */
    size?: number;

    /**
     * Size of the icon container (the colored square) in pixels.
     * @default 24
     */
    refugeSize?: number;

    /**
     * Whether to render a colored background behind the icon.
     * @default true
     */
    withBackground?: boolean;

    /**
     * Border radius variant of the icon container.
     * @default 'm'
     */
    radius?: 'm' | 'l';

    /**
     * Alpha (opacity) of the icon foreground color.
     * @default 1
     */
    colorAlpha?: number;
}
```
<!-- props:end -->

---

## Examples

### Default

```tsx
import {GoalIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<GoalIcon goalId={456} />
```

### Custom size

```tsx
// Larger icon container with a larger SVG inside
<GoalIcon goalId={456} size={20} refugeSize={32} />
```

### Without background

```tsx
// Renders only the colored SVG, no background square
<GoalIcon goalId={456} withBackground={false} />
```

### Alongside goal name

```tsx
import {GoalIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

export const GoalLabel = ({goal}: {goal: {shortId: number; summary: string}}) => (
    <div style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
        <GoalIcon goalId={goal.shortId} />
        <span>{goal.summary}</span>
    </div>
);
```

### Multiple goals (each gets a unique color)

```tsx
const goals = [
    {shortId: 1, summary: 'Increase retention'},
    {shortId: 2, summary: 'Launch mobile app'},
    {shortId: 3, summary: 'Reduce churn'},
];

goals.map((g) => (
    <div key={g.shortId} style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
        <GoalIcon goalId={g.shortId} />
        <span>{g.summary}</span>
    </div>
));
```
